summary: Drives AI mode transitions on the pit machine: reads the current mode state at this+0x184 (this[97]) and, for states 0, 1 and 4, forwards an unchanged this to StateChangeNotify to record and dispatch the transition. State 0 and state 4 both request state 1; state 1 requests state 0. Any other state produces no transition and returns the remaining state-4 difference. Runs on the frame path, called by sub_42C440.

operations.description: Read the current AI mode state from this[97] (offset 0x184) and branch on its value.
If the state is 0, return the result of StateChangeNotify immediately.
State 0 path: call StateChangeNotify(this, 1) to activate the state 1 transition.
Compute v2 = state - 1 to test whether the state is 1.
If v2 is 0 (state was 1), return the result of StateChangeNotify immediately.
State 1 path: call StateChangeNotify(this, 0) to request the state 0 transition.
Compute result = v2 - 3, i.e. state - 4, to test whether the state was 4.
If result is 0 (state was 4), return the result of StateChangeNotify immediately.
State 4 path: call StateChangeNotify(this, 1) to request the state 1 reactivation transition.
For all other states, return the computed difference (state - 4) with no transition performed.
